text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and excited to help you turn your machine learning model into a simple Flutter app that takes an input, sends it to the model, and returns the result cleanly and reliably.

I’m Noor Halden, with 6 years of experience working with Python and machine learning tools including scikit-learn, PyTorch, pandas, XGBoost, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, and general ML workflows. I’ve built production-oriented ML solutions that connect models to real application logic, which makes this kind of integration work a strong fit for me.

One relevant project was a support ticket triage model for Kettlewell Support Co. I built a classifier that routed incoming helpdesk tickets to 14 queues and served it with FastAPI. That system reduced median routing time from 6 hours to 4 minutes, showing my experience building practical model-serving workflows that are stable and easy to integrate into an application.

Another relevant project was clinical note summarisation for Brightwell Clinics. I built a LoRA-tuned Flan-T5 model that drafted visit summaries after names, dates, and IDs were masked. That work achieved ROUGE-L 0.41 and reduced clinician editing time by 38% in a 6-week trial. This project strengthened my experience with model integration, inference flows, and making ML outputs usable in a product setting.

For your Flutter app, I can help structure the flow so the app collects the user input, sends it to your model endpoint or inference layer, and displays the prediction or response clearly. If needed, I can also help with basic API design, request/response handling, and making sure the app remains simple and lightweight.

I like keeping implementations straightforward, maintainable, and focused on the actual user flow. If you already have the model ready, I can work with that and help connect it to the Flutter frontend in a clean way.

I’d be glad to discuss your model format, the input type, and the best way to expose it for the app.
